entities.summary: Mir Yusif Mir Heydar oglu Mirbabayev, better known as Miri Yusif, is an Azerbaijani rapper, singer, songwriter and director. Miri Yusif first emerged as a hip hop artist, part of Dayirman, which released their debut album Qurd in 2001.
